messages.subject: Is there a way to add a grid.table() to a ggplot2 plot
parts:
Hi again,
Is there a way to add a grid table inside a ggplot2 plot?
http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=tips:graphics-grid:table

Is there an example somewhere?

Thanks in advance i hope someone knows the answer because grid.tables
look cool

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to add a grid.table() to a ggplot2 plot
parts:
Hi,

A proof-of-principle is given in the ggExtra package,


require(gridExtra)
require(ggExtra)

dsmall <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds), 100), ]
str(dsmall)
d <- ggplot(dsmall, aes(carat, price)) +
annotate("table", x=1, y=10000, table=head(iris[, 1:3], 3)) +
geom_point()
d

HTH,

baptiste

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to add a grid.table() to a ggplot2 plot
parts:
Hi,


To change the size you can use the global gpar() of the tableGrob,

annotate("table", x=1, y=Inf, table=head(iris[, 1:3], 3), gp=gpar(cex=0.5))

and/or play with the individual components such as cell margins and
header text size etc. See the complete list of arguments in
?tableGrob.

I'm not sure why but the previous example fails for me with y=Inf. In
any case, the placement is relative to the center of the table (I
think), and I have not really thought of a way to specify hjust/vjust.
Since the table grob knows its actual size, in theory it should be
possible to use this information in an improved ggplot2 geom.

HTH,

baptiste

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to add a grid.table() to a ggplot2 plot
parts:
This seems to do the trick, I've committed the change,

GeomTable <- proto(Geom, {
objname <- "table"
desc <- "Custom table grob"

draw <- function(., data, scales, coordinates, table,
just=c("centre", "centre"), ...) {
with(coordinates$transform(data, scales), {
g <- tableGrob(table, ...)
width <- grobWidth(g)
height <- grobHeight(g)
g <- editGrob(g, vp=viewport(x = x, y = y, width=width,
height=height, just = just))
ggname(.$my_name(), g)
})
}

required_aes <- c("x", "y")
default_aes <- function(.)
aes(x=0.5, y=0.5)
default_stat <- function(.) StatIdentity
guide_geom <- function(.) "table"

draw_legend <- function(., data, ...) { }


icon <- function(.) { }

examples <- function() {#

require(gridExtra)
require(ggExtra)

d <- ggplot(dsmall, aes(carat, price)) +
annotate("table", x=1, y=10000, table=head(iris[, 1:3], 3),
just=c("right","top")) +
geom_point()
d

}
})

geom_table <- GeomTable$build_accessor()
